items.title: 67260_Freddie Moore oral history interview
items.q: We had an eight piece band. We were supposed to be there sixteen weeks. I guess it was around eight weeks at the Savoy... They had a drummer by the name of George Brunis in the band.

ctx.x: The Blue Note was an established club there that had been around a while.

Yeah. The Blue Note, yeah. That was on the second floor, the second or third floor, the Blue Note. We had an eight piece band. We were supposed to be there sixteen weeks. I guess it was around eight weeks at the Savoy... They had a drummer by the name of George Brunis in the band. He recorded that number "Ugly Child."
